name: Pixel art restorations execute Clean Jaggies, Remove Strays, 1px Skeleton Thinning, and 47-Blob Contours
description: Verify drawing a jagged ball with stray pixels, coloring it, and applying staircase smoothing (De-Jaggy), stray removal, topological Zhang-Suen 1px thinning, and 47-blob autotile contour generation.

planSteps.description: Select the Ellipse tool (press O), ensure shape mode in context bar is 'Shape: Filled Solid', press down on canvas, drag diagonally for at least 150 pixels, and release to draw a prominent circle
Select the Flood Fill tool (press G), select a color, and click inside the circle to fill it
Select the Pen tool and add a few rough jagged strokes and isolated stray pixels along the outer edge of the ball
Click the 'PixiBud AI' tab button in the right inspector panel
Click the 'De-Jaggy' action button in the RotSprite & Cleanup section
Verify staircase corner artifacts around the ball are smoothed flat without blurring the artwork
Click the 'Remove Stray Pixels' action button
Verify orphaned single-pixel strays around the ball are purged from the canvas
Verify thick raster boundaries are eroded down to 1-pixel wide topological centerlines
Click the '47-Blob Autotile Edges' button in the tileset section
Verify a dedicated '47-Blob Contours' layer is created with 47-tile bitmask edge outlines
